court: District of Columbia Court of Appeals

issues.label: Rehabilitation relevant to eligibility inquiry
issues.why: Court must decide whether rehabilitation can count toward extraordinary and compelling reasons or only toward dangerousness.

issues.label: Effect of omitted federal rehabilitation-alone bar
issues.why: District statute lacks 28 U.S.C. § 994(t)'s exclusion, suggesting rehabilitation may factor into eligibility.

issues.label: Holistic versus piecemeal factor analysis
issues.why: Court must decide whether factors are assessed collectively or each individually for extraordinary and compelling reasons.

issues.label: Scope of catch-all provision (a)(3)
issues.why: Whether (a)(3)'s enumerated examples are exhaustive or merely illustrative of qualifying reasons.

issues.label: Age below 60 as contributing factor
issues.why: Whether sub-sixty age can be considered under (a)(3) despite explicit statutory age thresholds elsewhere.

issues.label: Whether age thresholds cabin catch-all
issues.why: Statute's explicit 60-year lines may or may not preclude weighing lesser age within (a)(3).

issues.label: Length of incarceration as factor
issues.why: Whether twenty-plus years served counts toward extraordinary and compelling circumstances outside categorical criteria.

issues.label: COVID-19 vulnerability finding
issues.why: Court must evaluate whether Allen's comorbidities constitute acute vulnerability to severe outcomes.

issues.label: Debilitating medical condition standard
issues.why: Whether Allen's medical conditions meet (a)(3)(A)'s incurable/debilitating threshold.

issues.label: Standard of review on appeal
issues.why: Whether statutory interpretation is reviewed de novo and factual findings for clear error.

issues.label: Statutory interpretation methodology
issues.why: Court must construe the statute's text, structure, and legislative purpose consistently.

issues.label: Relevance of federal alignment intent
issues.why: Legislative intent to align with federal law affects interpretation of divergent District provisions.

issues.label: Mandatory 'shall modify' consequence
issues.why: If eligibility and non-dangerousness are met, modification becomes mandatory, raising stakes of eligibility ruling.

issues.label: Movant's burden of proof
issues.why: Court must apply correct burden on defendant to establish extraordinary and compelling reasons.

issues.label: Role of victim-impact statements
issues.why: Whether and how victim opposition bears on eligibility versus the already-resolved dangerousness inquiry.

issues.label: Consideration of §§ 3142(g) and 3553(a) factors
issues.why: Statute directs use of these factors, potentially relevant beyond dangerousness.

issues.label: Remand versus reversal disposition
issues.why: Whether legal error requires remand for reconsideration or outright grant of relief.

issues.label: Harmless error assessment
issues.why: Whether any interpretive error affected the outcome given the record.

issues.label: Non-dangerousness finding unchallenged
issues.why: Court should treat the satisfied non-dangerousness requirement as settled and not reopen it.
